git_read.one_commit_scope: Existing acceptance evidence/test additions only; no runtime delta.

auth_capabilities.limitation: API permission and successful read do not prove future git push acceptance; no dry-run push or write probe performed.

production_deployment_direct_read.deployment_alias_asset_binding: Unavailable: immutable deployment URL redirected to Vercel authentication; public live alias asset was observed independently.

mapping_conclusion: GitHub deployment records label the current develop SHA Production and the local evidence-only HEAD Preview. Treat develop as the observed live release lane; this does not independently expose or alter Vercel project branch settings. Never infer production from a generic successful commit status alone.
release_requirements: Close existing fixed exit gates and production backend parity before the new frontend is directed at real users.
Review exact selection manifest and reject dependency/private/env/generated-output paths; preserve unrelated user work.
Freeze current sources and regenerate clean build/source manifests after pending performance changes; the selection snapshot is not a freeze.

Vercel build must receive only intended existing public environment variables; its build runs default production mode, unlike the locally proven --mode staging invocation. Validate environment selection on the deployed preview before release.
Push only reviewed selected commit/branch through normal Git; no forced update and no blanket promotion workflow. A develop push may trigger the observed live deployment.
Verify actual deployed commit, successful Vercel status, live served entry SHA, cache headers and fresh /squad and /account deep links; then actual authorized persona/Tracker smoke.

unsafe_existing_workflow.disposition: Do not invoke: it merges develop into main, applies production DB migrations, deploys functions and targets Netlify, outside this selective Vercel release procedure.
